title: Quit rates and absolute gaps
hook: Two stated cases: explore absolute rates rather than a relative headline.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How absolute rates rather than a relative headline affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Gap, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare absolute rates rather than a relative headline in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
